Comment: serverless-patch-cycle: agentless patch orchestration. RHEL: security advisories via dnf upgrade --security over SSH. Windows: countable updates (Defender excluded) via a one-shot SYSTEM scheduled task over WinRM. Phase D: per-cycle EMF metrics (serverless-patch-metrics) and SNS notification (serverless-patch-notify). Iteration 3: Windows updates still offered after the post-install rescan get up to two follow-up passes inside the same cycle, each after Windows servicing has settled.

Choices.Condition: {% $exec_mode in ['scan', 'patch'] and $type($exec_percent) = 'number' and $exec_percent > 0 and $exec_percent <= 100 and $type($exec_followups) = 'number' and $exec_followups >= 0 and $exec_followups <= 3 and $type($exec_followup_wait) = 'number' and $exec_followup_wait >= 60 and $exec_followup_wait <= 3600 %}

Invalid Mode.Cause: mode must be scan or patch, percent a number from 1 to 100, followups 0-3, followup_wait_s 60-3600

Discover Targets.Output: {% ( $all := [$states.result.Reservations.Instances.{'instance_id': InstanceId, 'ip': PrivateIpAddress, 'name': Tags[Key='Name'].Value, 'platform': Tags[Key='PatchOS'].Value, 'workload': Tags[Key='Workload'].Value}]; $count($exec_targets) = 0 ? $all : [$all[name in $exec_targets]] ) %}

WIN Needs Followup.Comment: A selected update still offered after a verified install gets another pass, at most max_followups.

WIN Followup Wait.Comment: Pass 2 waits fu_wait, pass 3 twice that, then the servicing check decides.

WIN Settle Check.Comment: Read-only. Waits until uptime >= 15 min, the Windows Modules Installer is idle and nothing is pending.

Assign.settle: {% {'settled': false, 'note': 'still busy after 60 checks, installed anyway', 'detail': $states.errorOutput.Cause} %}

WIN Followup Install.Comment: Follow-up pass: reinstall only the selected updates the rescan still found.

Route Failure.Comment: Errors after a verified Windows pass (passes is filled at the rescan) fall back to that rescan.

Record Metrics.Comment: EMF metrics + cost estimate + notification text. Never connects to a host. Output is the unchanged summary.

Assign.note_subject: {% 'serverless-patch ' & $exec_mode & ' run finished (metrics step failed): ' & $string($states.input.failed) & ' of ' & $string($states.input.hosts_total) & ' hosts failed' %}
Assign.note_message:
{% 'The metrics step failed, so this is the raw run summary.' & '

Metrics error: ' & $string($states.errorOutput) & '

Summary:
' & $string($states.input) %}
